description: Opening a PR routes into the post-PR watch loop by default: the overlord's fixed-default binary read of the original request decides watch_requested absent an explicit no-watch instruction, standard-delivery.json's github_review_decision state transitions watch_requested into github_review_loop, that state is bound to the hivemind:github-review-loop skill, and a quiet idle window elapsing during the watch routes to the review_window_elapsed terminal rather than looping forever

source.pattern: Default post-PR watch (fixed-default binary read, not a judgment call).
